# `discord-notify.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| message | Additional context or failure message to include in the notification | `string` | `` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array (e.g., ["self-hosted", "oke"]) | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |
| source_actor | Actor who triggered the run being reported. Defaults to the calling actor. | `string` | `` | no |
| source_branch | Branch of the run being reported. Defaults to the calling ref. | `string` | `` | no |
| source_repo | owner/repo of the run being reported. Defaults to the calling repo. Load-bearing for a fleet-wide caller: startup-failure-sweep.yml runs in github-workflows and reports on other repos, so without this every alert would name github-workflows as the repository that failed. | `string` | `` | no |
| source_run_url | URL of the run being reported. Defaults to the calling run. | `string` | `` | no |
| source_sha | Commit SHA of the run being reported. Defaults to the calling SHA. | `string` | `` | no |
| source_workflow | Name of the workflow being reported. Defaults to the calling workflow. | `string` | `` | no |

## Secrets

| Name | Description | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :------: |
| discord_webhook_url | Discord webhook URL for failure notifications | yes |
